beats.title: Make line q parallel to line p
beats.instruction: Drag point C until line q is parallel to line p.
beats.successMessage: Line q is now parallel to line p — the transversal makes the same angle with both lines.

steps.text: Lines p and q are parallel (indicated by the arrows). The transversal t crosses both at points E and F respectively.
Corresponding angles are congruent when lines are parallel. ∠1 at E (upper-right) equals the corresponding ∠5 at F (upper-right). So if m∠1 = 55°, then m∠5 = 55°.
Co-interior angles (same-side interior angles) lie between the parallel lines on the same side of the transversal. ∠4 (lower-right at E) and ∠6 (upper-left at F) are co-interior and sum to 180°.
Since m∠1 = 55°, the vertical angle ∠3 = 55° (lower-left at E). Co-interior: ∠3 + ∠6 = 180°, so m∠6 = 125°. Summary: corresponding angles are equal; co-interior angles are supplementary.

items.prompt: Which notation correctly states that line l₁ is parallel to line l₂?
items.explanation: The symbol ∥ means 'is parallel to.' The symbol ⊥ means perpendicular, ≅ means congruent.

items.prompt: Lines m and n are in different planes and never intersect. They are best described as…
items.explanation: Skew lines are non-intersecting lines that lie in different planes. Parallel lines must be coplanar.

items.prompt: Two lines in the same plane that never intersect are called…
hints: Recall the two requirements: same plane, and never meet.
Skew lines are in different planes. What do we call same-plane non-intersecting lines?
Lines in the same plane that never intersect are parallel.

items.prompt: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One co-interior (same-side interior) angle measures 112°. Find the other co-interior angle.
hints: Co-interior angles have a special relationship when lines are parallel.
Co-interior angles are supplementary — they add up to 180°.

items.prompt: Parallel lines a and b are cut by a transversal. A corresponding angle at line a measures 3x + 7 degrees and its corresponding angle at line b measures 5x − 19 degrees. Find x.
hints: Corresponding angles are congruent when lines are parallel.

items.prompt: Line j has slope 2/3. Which line is parallel to line j?
hints: Parallel lines in the coordinate plane have a specific slope relationship.
Parallel lines (that are not the same line) have equal slopes.
A line parallel to slope 2/3 also has slope 2/3.

testItems.prompt: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. A corresponding angle on the first line is 72°. What is the corresponding angle on the second line?
Identify the type of angle pair: two angles on the same side of a transversal, between the parallel lines.
Parallel lines r and s are cut by a transversal. A co-interior angle at line r is 74°. Find the co-interior angle at line s.
Which of the following is a correct statement about parallel lines?
choices: Parallel lines can be in different planes.
Parallel lines intersect at exactly one point.
Parallel lines are coplanar and never intersect.
testItems.explanation: Parallel lines must be coplanar. Non-coplanar non-intersecting lines are skew, not parallel.

testItems.prompt: Parallel lines j and k are cut by a transversal. An alternate interior angle at j measures 2x + 11 degrees and the alternate interior angle at k measures 4x − 25 degrees. Find x.
testItems.explanation: Alternate interior angles are equal: 2x + 11 = 4x − 25 → 36 = 2x → x = 18.

testItems.prompt: Line m has equation y = 3x − 4. Which equation represents a line parallel to m?
testItems.explanation: Parallel lines have equal slopes. The slope of m is 3, so y = 3x + 7 is parallel.

testItems.prompt: Parallel lines p and q are cut by a transversal. One co-interior angle is expressed as 6x + 4 degrees. The other is 2x + 20 degrees. Find the measure of the larger co-interior angle.
